results.title: Dear Dakota
results.overview: This documentary acts as a love letter to floor five of Te Puni Village for the year of 2026, by exploring the many, many different aspects of the lives of the residents.

results.title: Harvest
results.overview: A man gets abducted and must fight to escape.

results.title: Adam Conover: Big Divorce Energy
results.overview: In his hilariously raw and unexpectedly vulnerable special Big Divorce Energy, Adam Conover talks sex and self-discovery, dating after divorce and why straight men are the most repressed people in America.

results.title: 4C's Monster Movie
results.overview: A Monster Movie, brought to you by 4C.

results.title: LOOTER PLANE
results.overview: A 17 years old boy who didn't write his literature assignment, so he and his best friend planned to deliver the assignment he made for him during class and they called this plan "Looter Plane".

results.title: Home
results.overview: The film is set in a self-storage facility: an anonymous, sterile place made up of countless storage units. For the film’s characters, however, these spaces become places where they can exist without judgement. Between shelves, boxes and locked doors, each character creates a fragile, personal world of their own, transforming the impersonal storage units into places where longing, intimacy and vulnerability can find expression. Their stories form a quiet portrait of a society in which one needs a place outside of everyday life to fully be oneself.

results.title: Skjulet
results.overview: Krispin works for the Swedish intelligence services and when something goes missing from a top secret facility in Luleå he is burdened with an enormous secret...

results.title: Rowing
results.overview: Nele’s whole life is centered around rowing. Together with her best friend Dina, she trains every single day without exception. But Dina is struggling with her own body – her skin is turning scaly and spikes start growing out of her back. While Nele tries to keep her focused on training, Dina decides to listen to her body and surrender to the transformation. Not only is their shared passion at risk of falling apart, so too is their friendship in jeopardy.

results.title: Where Little Gods Sleep
results.overview: ‘Where Little Gods Sleep’ is a documentary that explores the multi-faceted experiences of two of the Sin Ee Lye Heng troupe members, the third-generation successor Christine Ang, and apprentice Seri. Through their stories a comprehensive look at the steadfast troupe can be formed; Christine lovingly brings us back to her youth spent learning Iron-rod puppetry and the cultural teachings that came with the practice, while Seri offers a newer perspective on the craft. Ultimately, Where Little Gods Sleep is a story about old traditions, how time has moulded them as arts and society evolve, what we can give to our passions, and more importantly, what they can give back to us.

results.title: God is Real
results.overview: After successfully covering up Paul McCartney's death, two CIA agents are tasked with the impossible... convince the entire world that God is real.

results.title: Maybe We Could Have Killed Each Other Last Night
results.overview: After meeting on Halloween, Mitsuhiro and Sakuna marry while each hides a very different identity: he is a former yakuza, and she is a successful entrepreneur. Their life together seems blissful until misunderstandings make each suspect the other of having an affair. As suspicion spirals, the couple’s attempt to protect their marriage takes a dangerously absurd turn.

results.title: The Blue Hour
results.overview: "The Blue Hour remains as a work of meditation rather than the previous ones like An Act of Resilience who observe the process of wanderings and how time and space collapse under the remains of a new geography, a motion over stillness of life. A film trying to maintain the concrete to the spiritual, the light and the darkness, the resistance over indifference, this is rather a work of reflections and how much our lives aren't the same as we were before the mirrors gives us a strange world of movement and dynamics with objects and performers."

results.title: Schon immer
results.overview: Manuel and Adrian have known each other forever. But recently, Adrian has made some cool new friends. When Manuel tries to join the group during school break, they are watching a couple of girls dancing to Adrian and Manuel’s favorite song. Manuel makes no secret of the fact that he likes the song, but Adrian suddenly backs out in front of his new friends and humiliates Manuel. When Manuel confronts Adrian the next day, the latter continues to dodge the issue – and Manuel has to ask himself seriously whether he wants to hold on to the friendship any longer.

results.title: Dhood (Sandstorm)
results.overview: Set against the vast expanse of the Thar desert, an isolated family's desperate wishes and psychological friction trigger a dark domestic countdown, threatening to reduce their household entirely into dust
